_comment: FICTIONAL DEMONSTRATION DATA. Names, locations, prices, amenities and descriptions are illustrative; none of these are real or verified properties. Single source for supabase/seed.sql (npm run db:seed) and the in-app demo mode (/demo/stays).

properties.name: Green Valley Farm Stay
properties.summary: Demo listing: a farmhouse stay among paddy fields and coconut palms.
properties.description: DEMONSTRATION LISTING — SAMPLE DATA. This fictional farm stay shows how a family-friendly farmhouse appears on Hasiru Nidhi: two bedrooms opening onto a verandah, home-style meals and mornings among coconut palms. It is not a real property; the location, price, photographs and availability are illustrative.
properties.house_rules: Demo house rules: quiet after 10 PM. No smoking inside. Pets are not allowed. Please keep the garden gates closed.

images.alt: Sunrise over paddy and coconut palms (illustrative image)

properties.name: Countryside Garden Cottage
properties.summary: Demo listing: a standalone cottage with its own garden and fire pit.
properties.description: DEMONSTRATION LISTING — SAMPLE DATA. A fictional one-bedroom cottage for couples and small families, with a courtyard garden and an evening fire pit. It exists only to demonstrate search, filters, price breakdowns and booking requests; nothing about it is real.
properties.house_rules: Demo house rules: no loud music after 9 PM. Fire pit only with the host's supervision.

properties.name: Forest Edge Eco Retreat
properties.summary: Demo listing: a low-impact retreat at the edge of a forest.
properties.description: DEMONSTRATION LISTING — SAMPLE DATA. A fictional eco-retreat used to demonstrate a larger group stay with a cleaning fee and a minimum stay. Solar water heating, rainwater harvesting and forest walks are described for illustration only and are not claims about any real property.
properties.house_rules: Demo house rules: walk quietly near the forest edge. No drones. Please carry waste back to the bins provided.

images.alt: Forest path with red soil (illustrative image)

properties.name: Riverside Nature Escape
properties.summary: Demo listing: a calm riverside stay with a two-night minimum.
properties.description: DEMONSTRATION LISTING — SAMPLE DATA. A fictional riverside retreat used to test minimum-stay rules and the availability calendar. The river, the verandah corridor and the quiet mornings are illustrative; the photograph is a stand-in and does not show a real riverside property.
properties.house_rules: Demo house rules: no swimming without a guide. Keep the riverside path clear at night.

properties.name: Organic Farm Experience
properties.summary: Demo listing: a working-garden stay priced per guest, with harvest activities.
properties.description: DEMONSTRATION LISTING — SAMPLE DATA. A fictional organic farm used to demonstrate per-guest pricing and activity-led stays: vegetable harvesting, composting and farm-to-table meals. None of the produce, certifications or practices described are real or verified.
properties.house_rules: Demo house rules: closed shoes in the fields. Children must be accompanied during farm activities.

properties.name: Weekend Cycling Retreat
properties.summary: Demo listing: a cycling-friendly base with early breakfasts and quiet lanes.
properties.description: DEMONSTRATION LISTING — SAMPLE DATA. A fictional retreat for weekend riders: bicycles to borrow, early-start breakfasts and quiet tree-lined lanes. It also demonstrates a listing with weekend pricing and a two-night minimum. Nothing here describes a real business.
properties.house_rules: Demo house rules: helmets are compulsory on the cycling lanes. Bicycles must be returned by sunset.
